badName: A repo name starts with a letter or a digit and has only letters, digits, -, _ and ., up to 64 characters
badGithub: Give a GitHub repository address, such as https://github.com/botiverse/raft-source
notRepoName: "{name}" cannot be a repo name: use a simple English folder name, such as clock-in
outside: A repo must be inside the work folder, not linked to somewhere outside it
notChecked: The repo has not been checked: refresh GitHub's state

check.exited: The repo's check .vibevalley/check failed: exit status {code}

exists: "{name}" already exists: pick another repo name
cloneFailedGh: The download failed: check the GitHub sign-in, the repository's permissions and the network, then retry
cloneFailed: The download failed: check that the repository is public, the address is right and the network works; it stops after 3 minutes, and can be retried

github.noPermission: The repository's permissions could not be checked
github.noneConfigured: Not configured: set a GitHub Token in Settings (or GITHUB_TOKEN), or install and sign in with gh
github.tokenInvalid: GitHub Token is invalid or lacks permission

publish.missingCredentials: No GitHub credentials configured: set a GitHub Token in Settings (or GITHUB_TOKEN), or sign in with gh CLI
publish.platformFailed: Hosting platform failed: {stage}. Check your GitHub Token or CLI login.
publish.pushedWithoutLink: SHA {sha} was pushed, but no PR/MR link was confirmed: {why}. Retry to recover an open request.
publish.userOnly: Only the user on this computer can publish an existing branch
publish.pushUnconfirmed: Push of SHA {sha} was not confirmed. No PR/MR creation was attempted; inspect the remote before retrying.

mount.emptyPath: Provide a local repository folder path
mount.notGit: "{path}" is not a Git repository yet (enable Git initialization to mount it)
mount.unmountManaged: "{name}" is a managed project repository and cannot be unmounted
